in_sanskrit.name: अग्निवेष
in_sanskrit.meaning: Fire Deity, Agni (God of fire) + वेष (Wearer/Holder)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds or wears the fire deity Agni

in_hindi.name: अग्निवेष
in_hindi.meaning: अग्नि (Agni) + वेष (वेष, वहनाते रहनाते रूप दिवास दिवास से वहनाते रहनाते रूप जीवन के लिए पहननेवाले)
in_hindi.long_meaning: अग्नि (Agni, the fire god) को रक्षा करनेवाले, या अग्नि को साथ लेनेवाले

in_tamil.name: அக்னிவேஷ்
in_tamil.meaning: அக்கி (Agni) + வேஷ் (வழியில் போகும் அல்லது அளிவாய் அளியவிருப்பவன்)
in_tamil.long_meaning: அக்கி (Agni, the fire god) அல்லது அல்லவாழ் அளிவாய் அளியவிருப்பவன்

in_telugu.name: అగ్నివేష్
in_telugu.long_meaning: అగ్ని (Agni, the fire god) అప్పటిగా పేదేపోయేదు

in_marathi.name: Agnivesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnivesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agnivesh means 'Fire God'. Agni is the god of fire, and the suffix 'vesh' indicates that the god is the possessor of that quality. In Hinduism, Agni is considered as the god of the hearth, and he is also the god of the sacrificial fire.

in_bengali.name: Agnivesh

in_bengali.long_meaning: Agnivesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Agnivesh means 'Fire God'. Agni is the god of fire, and the suffix 'vesh' indicates that the god is the possessor of that quality. In Hinduism, Agni is considered as the god of the hearth, and he is also the god of the sacrificial fire.
